# Run-to-completion study tables (generated by rtc_analysis.py; PREREG-run-to-completion.md)

112320 simulations; configurations per band: realistic 500, stress 580.
Rates are means over configurations; latency percentiles are medians over configurations of the per-configuration value. pp = percentage points; intervals are 95 % paired bootstrap. F = fail rate = busy + abandoned.
